title: Constrained-xAIOps: Trust-Gated Selective Anomaly Detection and Explainable Root-Cause Analysis Under Incident-Driven Telemetry Missingness
description: Constrained-xAIOps is a data-quality-aware, explainable AIOps framework designed for resource-constrained cloud environments. It resolves the MNAR Abstention Paradox across 375 real-world failure cases in Online Boutique, Sock Shop, and Train Ticket, delivering up to +56.8% accuracy advantage over state-of-the-art causal baselines with sub-4ms inference latency.
